title: Sysmic v8.0.0: Fractal Tomography and the Fisher Information Barrier of Seismicity
description: Companion software to Firmenich et al. (2026), JGR Solid Earth. Sysmic implements precision-calibrated Bayesian fractal tomography of seismic catalogs via the Grassberger-Procaccia correlation integral and MCMC inference of latent dimensionality D3 (emcee, 32 walkers, Uniform[1.5, 3.0] prior). Identifies the Fisher Information Barrier (sigma_c = 2.3 +/- 0.4 km) — the precision threshold beyond which Bayesian D3 inference collapses to the boundary prior. Validated on seven seismic networks across five tectonic regimes.
